row.name: directory_users_clerk_user_unique
row.where: "identity"."directory_users"."deleted_at" is null and "identity"."directory_users"."clerk_user_id" is not null

row.name: connections_session_limits_check
row.value: ("max_session_seconds" is null or "max_session_seconds" >= 300) and ("idle_timeout_seconds" is null or "idle_timeout_seconds" >= 300)

row.name: directories_allow_drop_check
row.value: ("allow_drop_up_to" is null and "allow_drop_at" is null) or ("allow_drop_up_to" >= 0 and "allow_drop_at" is not null)

row.name: directory_groups_mail_check
row.value: ("mail_address" is null) = ("mail_kind" is null) and ("mail_kind" is null or "mail_kind" in ('list', 'shared'))

row.name: directory_mailboxes_delete_check
row.value: (("next" = 'delete') = ("delete_at" is not null)) and (("next" = 'delete') = ("delete_after_days" is not null)) and ("delete_after_days" is null or "delete_after_days" between 7 and 365)

row.name: workspace_settings_leaver_check
row.value: "leaver_action" in ('keep', 'forward_manager', 'delete_after') and (("leaver_action" = 'delete_after') = ("leaver_days" is not null)) and ("leaver_days" is null or "leaver_days" between 7 and 365)

row.name: workspace_settings_session_bounds_check
row.value:
("max_session_seconds" is null or "max_session_seconds" between 900 and 7776000)
        and ("idle_timeout_seconds" is null or "idle_timeout_seconds" between 300 and 2592000)

row.name: workspace_settings_ip_grace_check
row.value:
("ip_grace_user_id" is null) = ("ip_grace_address" is null)
        and ("ip_grace_user_id" is null) = ("ip_grace_until" is null)
